messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法直接取得即時的交通資訊。若您想了解紐約市目前的交通狀況，建議使用以下工具：

| 工具 | 特色 | 如何使用 |
|------|------|----------|
| **Google Maps** | 提供實時路況、擁堵程度、預估通行時間 | 在地圖上輸入「New York」或具體路段，查看「交通」圖層 |
| **Waze** | 社群即時更新，能看到事故、警察、交通管制等 | 下載 App，開啟即時路況 |
| **NYC DOT Traffic** | 紐約市交通局官方網站，提供主要道路的即時流量圖 | 訪問 <https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/traffic/traffic.shtml> |
| **Apple Maps** | 內建即時交通資訊 | 在 iPhone 或 Mac 上搜尋「New York」並切換到「交通」視圖 |

如果您需要更詳細的路線規劃或特定路段的擁堵預測，這些平台都能提供即時更新。祝您順利！
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" meaning "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to provide real-time traffic info. We can use geocode_address? But that just geocodes an address. We need traffic data. There's no function for traffic. We might need to answer that we cannot provide real-time data. We can suggest using Google Maps or Waze. So respond accordingly.
